treatments.action: Review authentication strength, recovery paths, access scope and privileged roles.
required_evidence: Scoped policy export, test sign-in outcomes, role-review record and recovery-path test; validate all relevant identities, not a single example.

treatments.action: Separate backup administration and define service recovery needs with the service owner.
required_evidence: Restore an isolated representative backup, record recovered completeness and elapsed recovery against approved needs; assess dependencies and backup access separately.

treatments.action: Specify object/customer authorization and test positive and cross-customer negative cases.
required_evidence: Reproducible request/response evidence with synthetic identities; every relevant API operation covered or explicitly listed as untested.

treatments.action: Establish device inventory, encryption evidence and lost-device/session procedure.
required_evidence: Inventory coverage, encryption/recovery-key governance and a safe revocation exercise; no claim based only on a written policy.

treatments.action: Review supplier roles, access scope, service recovery and exit arrangements.
required_evidence: Reviewed responsibilities, access evidence, supplier assurance limitations and a tabletop dependency test. No contract or service commitment is signed by this exercise.

treatments.action: Map purpose and data categories; obtain a reasoned retention/deletion decision and assess privacy risks.
required_evidence: Approved rationale, legal/privacy review where needed, synthetic deletion and restore-handling test, and evidence of exceptions. A deletion job alone does not establish lawful processing.

treatments.action: Inventory versions, prioritize applicable weaknesses and verify remediation.
required_evidence: Scoped scan/version evidence before and after, applicability rationale, supported-version checks and time-limited exception decisions.

treatments.action: Define audit sources, access, retention, alert ownership and investigation workflow.
required_evidence: Synthetic test events traced from source to review, failure/missing-source checks and an incident exercise; do not infer business coverage from the separate ATLAS Wazuh lab.
